directions.internal_tls: Tonic 0.14.6 tls-ring; explicit private CA, node DNS and verified leaf identity; certificate control plane pending
directions.raft_transport_codec: bounded Prost Packet containing SCAPRPC1 versioned fixed-header envelope and opaque raft protobuf-codec bytes
directions.local_persistence: Bounded Store<AtomicBackend> policy with formal rocksdb 0.24.0 synchronous backend; incremental layout pending
directions.object_client: S3 SDK candidate; exact version/features/MSRV pending

durable_store_g0.integrity: SHA-256 via sha2 0.10.9; not authentication or rollback prevention
durable_store_g0.native_wal_recovery: AbsoluteConsistency; paranoid_checks=true; no permissive recovery fallback

serial_driver_g0.consensus: fixed real RawNode over formal Store
serial_driver_g0.execution: bounded synchronous single-cell driver; dedicated blocking execution required
serial_driver_g0.unit_io: controlled backend/application; explicit ticks and captured output
serial_driver_g0.native_unit_environment: RocksDB memory Env for isolated adapter calls; no disk recovery claims
serial_driver_g0.fault_transport: separate bounded IPC scheduling contracts and real TCP/mTLS three-process fault contracts
serial_driver_g0.sql_acceptance_scope: formal bounded CellApplication plus private native SQLite adapter; service assembly pending
serial_driver_g0.early_read_admission: ReadNotReady until current-term commit; no allocated ticket
serial_driver_g0.election_contracts: real tick PreVote/Vote; isolated-follower term stability; one-way partition with delayed ReadIndex ACK

peer_runtime_g0.execution: one serial blocking owner per cell; bounded asynchronous peer workers; monotonic automatic ticks without catch-up bursts
peer_runtime_g0.wire_format: SCAPRPC1; 80-byte little-endian header; explicit version/codec, cluster/cell/incarnation, from/to and bounded payload length
peer_runtime_g0.code_generation: handwritten minimal Tonic service and Prost message derives; no build.rs or first-party generated-code exclusion
peer_runtime_g0.receipt: Received version 1 means authenticated bounded inbox admission; never persistence, quorum, application acceptance or SQL publication
peer_runtime_g0.inbound_identity: TLS-verified leaf DER; private CA plus current SHA-256 pin/node/cell authorization and certificate validity; revalidate policy revision and expiry before driver handoff
peer_runtime_g0.outbound_identity: private CA and node-{node_id}.cluster-{cluster_id:032x}.scap.internal DNS; runtime creates a fresh PeerClient for every delivery
peer_runtime_g0.standalone_client_reuse: PeerClient may be reused serially; server certificate validity is checked at TLS handshake, not every RPC on an existing channel
peer_runtime_g0.resource_admission: global connection permits before accept; global RPC permits before decode; bounded fields/entries and inbox/request/delivery counts and bytes
peer_runtime_g0.outbound_scheduling: independent ordinary and snapshot worker per peer; one shared finite queue/in-flight payload budget retained until completion or cancellation
peer_runtime_g0.delivery_completion: live attempt identity, original deadline, Raft term and latest snapshot attempt guard feedback; completion is not commitment
peer_runtime_g0.timeouts: absolute delivery deadline includes queueing, connection and send; no implicit application retry
peer_runtime_g0.tcp_options: explicit TCP_NODELAY on accepted sockets; configuration failure rejects that connection
peer_runtime_g0.shutdown: close admission and cancel queued/in-flight async work; join workers within deadline or abort; started synchronous storage I/O has no forced-cancellation guarantee
peer_runtime_g0.unit_boundary: controlled clock/backend/application/driver/network effects and isolated native adapter calls; no three-process fault history in unit profiles
peer_runtime_g0.integration_boundary: three real processes with separate RocksDB directories and end-to-end mTLS; synthetic bounded application payloads, not SQLite SQL execution

cell_state_machine_g0.execution: pure deterministic Application; no SQL replay, I/O, clock or page publication
cell_state_machine_g0.state_format: SCAPCELL version 1; bounded binary codec and SHA-256
cell_state_machine_g0.command_format: SCAPCMD! version 1; bounded binary codec and SHA-256
cell_state_machine_g0.limits: replicated and compared to expected local configuration
cell_state_machine_g0.genesis: explicit bootstrap; identical nonempty application and snapshot atomically stored at term/index 1
cell_state_machine_g0.recovery_binding: same Store view cell identity and durable applied entry term/index; also required after snapshot-only install
cell_state_machine_g0.authorization: trusted admission followed by replicated current policy and auth_epoch recheck before historical replay
cell_state_machine_g0.audit_binding: original Admission retained in accepted transactions, cancellations and administrative records
cell_state_machine_g0.physical_payload: opaque bounded bytes with digest; engine format and baseline validation remain adapter responsibilities
cell_state_machine_g0.deduplication: semantic fingerprint distinct from physical digest; retain original receipt, position and result
cell_state_machine_g0.ordinary_rejection: only the attempted command at its exact term/index; not permanent request cancellation
cell_state_machine_g0.cancellation: persistent ordered ResolveOrCancel; absent Lookup remains Unknown
cell_state_machine_g0.retention: all accepted physical transactions and request/admin records; reject at capacity, no automatic GC
cell_state_machine_g0.recovery_api: trusted internal worker only; not an ordinary user READ export endpoint

not_initially_adopted: TiKV grpcio runtime and complete kvproto service
yatp without a measured scheduling need
TiKV allocator or nightly toolchain by default
Raft Engine without separate recovery proof

sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_request_format: SCAPSQL1 exact SQL and typed positional parameters; SHA-256 fingerprint
sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_result_format: SCAPRES1 bounded complete typed transaction results
sqlite_adapter_g0.physical_format: SCAPIMG! version 1; fixed 4096-byte pages; full logical image base and result SHA-256
sqlite_adapter_g0.open_policy: fresh exclusive runtime-owned directory only; no old cache or sidecar reuse
sqlite_adapter_g0.recovery_policy: complete cell history from empty image after ReadIndex and decode_bound plus exact recovery target
sqlite_adapter_g0.physical_commit: pre-native-publish gate; ACK after durable business acceptance and final COMMIT success
sqlite_adapter_g0.no_physical_changes: same-image empty-page transaction and original result still committed through cell
sqlite_adapter_g0.idempotency: current-authorized preflight plus ordered commit-time check; historical receipt and result preserved
sqlite_adapter_g0.configuration: FULL sync; cache_spill OFF; no auto checkpoint; SQLite max_page_count bounded
sqlite_adapter_g0.sql_surface: private connection; explicit batch; deny unknown authorizer action/function
sqlite_adapter_g0.failure_policy: stop writer; retain accepted receipt for post-acceptance failures; never replay UNKNOWN automatically

sqlite_network_g0.outcome_format: SCAPOUT! version 1; maximum 512 bytes; exact applied position and checksum
sqlite_network_g0.tracked_binding: cluster/cell/incarnation/node/boot/sequence plus exact command bytes and entry term
sqlite_network_g0.outcome_release: only after durable application state and applied position
sqlite_network_g0.context: one RAII invocation per SQL call; current Admission, original absolute deadline and cancellation
sqlite_network_g0.preflight: fresh Safe ReadIndex, same-view decode_bound, current READ and WRITE, active owner and exact predecessor
sqlite_network_g0.recovery: claim; fresh view; physical Image recovery; new exclusive native directory; activate exact revision/hash; final current authority check
sqlite_network_g0.threads: private SQL thread; separate Runtime owner and async network workers
